name: GitLab
description: Give agents Git access to GitLab repositories on GitLab.com or a self-managed instance.

methods.label: Access token
methods.whenToUse: Use a personal, project, or group access token for clone, fetch, and push on one GitLab instance.
methods.guidanceMd: Create an access token with the `read_api`, `read_repository`, and `write_repository` scopes. Choose a dedicated agent to give one agent its own GitLab identity.

tenantFields.label: GitLab URL
tenantFields.helperMd: Use `https://gitlab.com` or the HTTPS address of your self-managed GitLab. A repository link or clone URL from the instance also works.

warnings: Shell Git receives this token for the GitLab host during the run and is not constrained by per-tool Ask-first controls.
